pay_detail: No pay is mentioned on the page. Cadets help with security and traffic control at events.
name: Police Cadet Program
what_you_do: Meet at the police department twice a month for training. You help with security and traffic at community events during the year.
who_can_apply: At least 14 years old, finished 8th grade, and not older than 21. Needs a C average or better, and no serious arrests or convictions.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Download the cadet application and turn it in at the front desk, 1350 Aurora Ave. A committee checks references and does a background check and an interview. Questions: NPDCadets@naperville.il.us.
notes: The police internship on the same site is for college students, so it is not listed. The department points younger people to the cadet program.
